title: Chapter 86 The Majesty Of Qin Law
content:
Chapter 86 The Majesty Of Qin Law

Heifu looked at the situation outside the yard, which was very similar to the later policemen who were surrounded when they were abducting people.

In the eyes of the residents outside, the person inside the house is the person who took away their own or their neighbor's wife, and is also the person who will bring bad luck to this place. They had been waiting outside for a long time. Under the loud call from the inner prison door, they began to become more and more anxious and uneasy...

At this time, Li Xian also walked into the room, wiped the sweat from his forehead, and said with some trembling: "Pavilion Chief, the situation is not good. People from outside may rush in at any time! I don't know when Xiao Tao will be able to move the reinforcements." Come!"

Before Hei Fu came, he left Xiao Tao outside and told him to act accordingly. Heifu thought that after hearing the whistle in Li Zhong, Xiao Tao should have immediately rushed down the mountain and went to various pavilions, villages and even the county town to ask for help. He had already run for several miles, right?

"Can't wait until dark."

Heifu looked at everyone in the room and made up his mind: "We have to get out before nightfall, otherwise, there will be no way out!"

The dark night can inspire cruelty and evil thoughts in people. If the night is long, all they need to do is throw in a fire, and they will die violently. Hei Fu doesn't want to take the risk and wait for rescue who doesn't know when it will arrive.

Ji Ying was a little unbelievable: "Brother Heifu, are we going to go out like this?"

"We have a crossbow machine, which can deter the local people from approaching."

At this time, Heifu handed the two-foot sword to Ji Ying, and he took the hand crossbow. This hand crossbow was seized from the tomb robbery case. It is indeed a good thing that is strictly prohibited from being circulated among the people. It is so powerful that it can even be shot through the human body within ten steps. If it is hit in the vitals at twenty steps, there is no way to survive. It is the most powerful weapon in this kind of alley containment. Lethal weapons.

"But although the hand crossbow is powerful, it only has one..." Ji Ying murmured.

There are 200 people surrounded by darkness outside. Although they don't have any weapons, they can be smashed into pulp with just stones. It is difficult for one person to fight against the fourth hand. No matter how good Heifu and Dongmen Bao are in martial arts, even if their hand crossbows can intimidate everyone from making mistakes, it is useless...

"Now, all I can do is take a gamble."

Heifu stood up and asked Ji Ying and Li Xian to escort Li Zheng and Tian Dian respectively. By the way, he also blocked the mouths of these two people to prevent them from talking nonsense.

"We still have two hostages in hand, and we may be able to convince them to use a weapon of caution."

"This is not guaranteed."

Li Xian muttered: "The people in Blind Mountain are used to being cruel. If they feel that they are in danger of annihilation, they may not care about the lives of the local officials and clan leaders, and they will prevent us from getting out."

Heifu nodded: "In that case, in addition to weapons and hostages, we also have a third thing."

"What is it?" Everyone in the room looked at Heifu, wondering if he had any other tricks up his sleeve that he hadn't revealed yet.

Heifu took out the two-foot slip tied to his waist, which was densely packed with articles of Qin law.

"And the majesty of Qin Lu!"

Everyone was shocked when they heard this.

"Qin Lu's... majesty?"

Heifu knew that what he said would be funny in future generations, and it would definitely make criminals with white blades laugh out loud.

Laws, don't laws have immediate validity and often become a dead letter in front of thugs and villains? The weapon of law is often effective only in the trial after the crime is committed. .

But in Qin, where the country was governed by Legalism, it was different.

The Qin Code is not a civil code that is gentle to everyone in later generations, but a cold and cruel ax and a stick that everyone has to weigh.

Heifu and the others are not anti-trafficking policemen who can be harassed and besieged by thugs and thugs at will. They are the eagle dogs of the imperial court, the jealous heavenly dogs of Anlu County. Anyone who dares to pull a hair on his tail will be cut off by law. Of the neck!

"Although I don't want to admit it, this is our last resort!"

…

The residents outside were already debating whether to swarm in or to set fire and smoke to force people out, but they didn't expect Heifu to come out on his own initiative and were suddenly shocked.

Seeing Heifu striding forward with a crossbow in his left hand and a two-foot slip in his right hand, they subconsciously stepped back.

In the eyes of the villagers, who had not left the village for a long time, the pavilion chief was already a very important official they knew, and they still had a sense of awe in their hearts...

Heifu also saw the fear of him from the people outside. Looking at the two hundred dark and thin faces, he said loudly:

"I am the chief of Huyang Pavilion, a Qin official appointed by the Qin government! You all know the matter. I came to Blind Mountain this time just to retrieve the woman who was robbed and sold... This matter has violated the law. If If you persist in your stubbornness and obstruct the handling of the case by the chief of the pavilion, your crime will be increased to one level and treated as gang robbery! By then, I am afraid you will not be able to escape death!"

Some people are whispering. In fact, they already know that this kind of thing is illegal, but everyone in the city is keeping it secret. Who knows? Until today, the matter was revealed by Heifu and others. What should we do now?

Although most of the people here are illiterate and live in remote areas, at any rate, several people go to serve in villages and counties every year, and they have more or less experienced the harshness of Qin's laws that make people talk about them. Unlike later generations, even if you beat the police or block the investigators, you will eventually be treated leniently because the law is not punishable, and nothing will happen to you.

At this time, I heard Hei Fu say again: "If you open the way and let us out, I may beg for mercy for you! Let you not die for your crime!"

Heifu was deceiving the people in the village, but after the reckoning, those who deserved to die would still die, those who deserved to be Chengdan would still be Chengdan, and he would not ask for any sympathy for the guilty people.

In the Qin State, unless the King of Qin personally issued the pardon order, there is no such thing as extrajudicial mercy!

Sure enough, as soon as this statement came out, everyone was in an uproar. When they learned that the crime would not lead to death, their stubborn resistance became a little less.

One step, two steps, Heifu is slowly moving forward.

Three steps, four steps, the people surrounding the outermost circle also retreated unconsciously.

This place is only fifty steps away from the inner gate. Hei Fu only needs a moment to leave...

At this time, Li Zheng and Tian Dian were also strangled one after another, and were escorted out by Ji Ying and Li Xian. Followed by Ju and four women who were robbed and sold. Although Ju was timid, he still had the courage to protect his daughter. Dongmen Leopard, on the other hand, was wearing armor and holding a halberd in both hands. No one dared to look into his fierce eyes.

Seeing that the leader of the village was caught, the residents were even more frightened, but when they saw that the woman they bought was among them, the families started shouting again.

"That woman was bought by my brothers and I together spent more than two thousand dollars!"

"What happens to the money when the person is gone!"

"Yes, you haven't given birth to a baby for me yet."

In the eyes of these fools, handing over money and handing over people is reasonable and reasonable. What’s the problem? How is this okay if they want to take away the woman they paid for?

So a dark-skinned man wanted to come over and forcefully drag away the crazy woman named "Ling". When the woman saw the man approaching, she suddenly showed fear on her face and started to scream.

Heifu raised his crossbow without hesitation and aimed it at the man!

"ah!"

The man fell to the ground and saw the crossbow arrow piercing deeply into his flesh, blood spurting out. He covered his thigh and screamed.

Can't shoot? nonexistent.

In this era, with Qin Lu endorsing him, Heifu can happily hit Zheng Zheng on the head with a bowl of chicken blood, and he can also pull the knife on the thugs and thugs without hesitation, instead of being timid and cowardly " Died in the line of duty."

But with this incident, the atmosphere became tense again. A group of villagers shouted and were about to rush forward, but were forced back by Hei Fu who was re-winding the crossbow.

"Whoever dares to come here will be the target of my crossbow!" Heifu raised his crossbow and pointed it at anyone who wanted to offend them.

Ji Ying and Li Xian, who were behind them, also placed their weapons on the necks of Li Zheng and Tian Dian, and shouted threats.

"If you act rashly again, these two people will be exposed to blood!"

Under the dual threat of the crossbow and the hostages, the residents retreated again. They slowly made way for a path, while Heifu and his dozen or so people walked through the middle as if they were walking on thin ice.

At this moment, the inner gate is only ten steps away from them...

However, there is still a person blocking the door! It was the inner prison gate that the residents had just organized to besiege, named "Zhong Sheng".

Zhong Sheng is the third most important figure in Blind Mountain besides Satsuma and Tian Dian, but in terms of age, he is a bit older than those two. And because he had served in the garrison and traveled to far and wide places, he had wider knowledge and more experience in dealing with Qin officials.

He had just come over to get weapons and planned to distribute them to the villagers, but unexpectedly Hei Fu and others were so bold and walked out directly. Zhong Sheng couldn't help but be slightly startled.

Seeing that Li Min was frightened by Hei Fu and made way out of the way, and was about to walk to the inner door, Zhong Sheng hurried over and stopped him loudly:

"Second and third sons, don't be fooled!"

Zhong Sheng pointed at Hei Fu and said: "This pavilion chief is lying to you. Li Zheng has told me a long time ago that as long as he bribes a woman who has been robbed and sold, it will be a dead end! As for other people, they will also be kidnapped. Even if you sit down, you have to be a Chengdan at the very least! You must not let them leave!"

…
